agent.problem: The question relies on the preceding story card: “that cup and dish” points back to context the baker can no longer see. It should itself explain that Jesus is addressing the scribes and Pharisees, who clean the outside of the cup and dish.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
